blocks.zh: 需求規格、配置與設計附錄
blocks.en: Appendices on Requirements, Configuration and Design Specifications

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives — 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand the purpose and structure of a Requirements Specification (RS) and when multiple levels of specification are needed. — 理解需求規格書 (RS) 的目的與結構，並判斷何時需要多層級規格。
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and structure of a Requirements Specification (RS) and when multiple levels of specification are needed.

blocks.zh: Apply the SMART criteria to write requirements that are verifiable and unambiguous. — 運用 SMART 原則撰寫可驗證、無歧義的需求條款。
blocks.en: Apply the SMART criteria to write requirements that are verifiable and unambiguous.

blocks.zh: Distinguish what belongs in a Requirements Specification versus what belongs in a Configuration/Design Specification. — 區分需求規格書與配置／設計規格書各自的職責範疇。
blocks.en: Distinguish what belongs in a Requirements Specification versus what belongs in a Configuration/Design Specification.

blocks.zh: Recognize the difference between a Configuration Specification (CS) for COTS/configured software and a Design Specification (DS) for custom applications. — 辨別 COTS 商業軟體的配置規格 (CS) 與客製軟體的設計規格 (DS) 之差異。
blocks.en: Recognize the difference between a Configuration Specification (CS) for COTS/configured software and a Design Specification (DS) for custom applications.

blocks.zh: Explain how traceability from requirements through design becomes the backbone of a validation plan. — 說明從需求到設計的可追溯性如何成為驗證計畫的骨幹。
blocks.en: Explain how traceability from requirements through design becomes the backbone of a validation plan.

blocks.zh: Identify common CDMO pitfalls in requirements capture and how to avoid scope creep. — 識別 CDMO 環境中需求捕捉的常見陷阱，並掌握防止範圍蔓延的方法。
blocks.en: Identify common CDMO pitfalls in requirements capture and how to avoid scope creep.

blocks.zh: Appendix D1 — Specifying Requirements: Introduction & Scope Appendix D1 — 需求規格：簡介與範圍
blocks.en: Appendix D1 — Specifying Requirements: Introduction & Scope

blocks.zh: 中文解說：需求規格的層級架構
blocks.en: Commentary: The Hierarchy of Requirements Specifications

blocks.zh: 需求層級架構：從 URS 到 CS/DS
blocks.en: Requirements hierarchy: from URS to CS/DS

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 第二版把原本的 URS + FRS 合併成單一的 Requirements Specification (RS)，但實務上理解層級仍很重要：
blocks.en: GAMP 5 Second Edition merges the former URS + FRS into a single Requirements Specification (RS), but in practice it is still important to understand the levels:

blocks.zh: URS（使用者需求規格）：「我需要系統能做什麼」—— 業務語言，不涉及技術實作。例：「系統需記錄每批培養基的配製人員與配製時間。」
blocks.en: URS (User Requirements Specification): "What I need the system to do" - written in business language, with no technical implementation. Example: "The system shall record the preparer and preparation time for each batch of culture media."

blocks.zh: FRS（功能需求規格）：「系統如何滿足上述需求」的功能描述 —— 說明輸入、輸出、計算邏輯。例：「配製記錄需包含欄位：日期/時間（系統自動戳記）、操作員 ID（從 LDAP 取得）、批號。」
blocks.en: FRS (Functional Requirements Specification): a functional description of "how the system meets the requirement above" - it describes inputs, outputs and calculation logic. Example: "The preparation record shall include the fields: date/time (automatically stamped by the system), operator ID (obtained from LDAP), batch number."

blocks.zh: CS/DS（配置/設計規格）：「技術上怎麼配置或設計實現」—— 詳見 Appendix D3。
blocks.en: CS/DS (Configuration/Design Specification): "how it is technically configured or designed" - see Appendix D3 for details.

blocks.zh: 比喻：蓋廠房的類比
blocks.en: Analogy: building a plant

blocks.zh: URS = 業主說「我要一棟 ISO 5 無菌室，能容納 10 條灌裝線」。
blocks.en: URS = the owner says, "I want an ISO 5 aseptic suite that can hold 10 filling lines."

blocks.zh: FRS = 建築師說「需要 12 換氣次數/時，溫濕度控制在 18–22°C，40–60% RH」。
blocks.en: FRS = the architect says, "We need 12 air changes per hour, with temperature and humidity controlled at 18–22°C and 40–60% RH."

blocks.zh: DS = 機電工程師說「選用 XXX 品牌 AHU，配置 HEPA H14 濾網，管路尺寸 DN200」。
blocks.en: DS = the MEP engineer says, "Use brand XXX AHUs with HEPA H14 filters and DN200 duct size."

blocks.zh: 規格層級不能混淆：業主不該在 URS 裡指定 AHU 型號；工程師也不應在 DS 裡重新定義業務目標。
blocks.en: The levels of specification must not be confused: the owner should not specify an AHU model in the URS, and the engineer should not redefine business goals in the DS.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務重點
blocks.en: CDMO practical points

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 在 LIMS、EBR 或 MES 專案中，直接跳進系統選型而沒有先完成 RS。結果是：需求由供應商的 demo 決定，而非由業務流程決定。審計時監管機構會問：「你的系統是否符合你的業務需求？」——如果沒有書面的 RS，這個問題無法回答。
blocks.en: In LIMS, EBR or MES projects, many CDMOs jump straight into system selection without first completing an RS. The result is that requirements are driven by the supplier's demo rather than by the business process. During an audit the regulator will ask, "Does your system meet your business needs?" - without a written RS, this question cannot be answered.

blocks.zh: D1.3.1 General Guidelines & Requirements Good Practice (SMART) D1.3.1 一般準則與需求良好實務 (SMART)
blocks.en: D1.3.1 General Guidelines & Requirements Good Practice (SMART)

blocks.zh: 中文解說：好的需求 vs. 壞的需求
blocks.en: Commentary: Good Requirements vs. Bad Requirements

blocks.zh: SMART 原則：可測試性是核心
blocks.en: The SMART criteria: testability is the core

blocks.zh: 五個 SMART 標準中，Testable（可測試）是最關鍵的。一條需求如果無法被測試，它就等於沒有意義——你不知道系統是否達標，也無法在驗證報告中引用它。
blocks.en: Of the five SMART criteria, Testable is the most critical. A requirement that cannot be tested is effectively meaningless - you cannot know whether the system meets it, and you cannot cite it in the validation report.

blocks.zh: CDMO LIMS 專案：URS 需求範例拆解
blocks.en: CDMO LIMS project: breaking down example URS requirements

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 要導入 LIMS 管理環境監控 (EM) 數據：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO is implementing a LIMS to manage environmental monitoring (EM) data:

blocks.zh: URS-EM-001（業務需求）：LIMS 應記錄所有 ISO 5 潔淨室的 viable particle 監控結果，並支援趨勢分析以識別超標警示。
blocks.en: URS-EM-001 (business requirement): The LIMS shall record viable particle monitoring results for all ISO 5 cleanrooms and support trend analysis to identify excursion alerts.

blocks.zh: URS-EM-002（安全需求）：環境監控數據一旦由 QC 人員審核簽核，不得被任何使用者修改或刪除。
blocks.en: URS-EM-002 (security requirement): Once EM data has been reviewed and signed off by QC personnel, it shall not be modifiable or deletable by any user.

blocks.zh: URS-EM-003（介面需求）：LIMS 應能自動接收來自 Biotest RCS 採樣器的數字輸出，無需手動鍵入。
blocks.en: URS-EM-003 (interface requirement): The LIMS shall automatically receive the digital output from the Biotest RCS sampler, without manual entry.

blocks.zh: URS-EM-004（法規需求）：系統應符合 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 第 9.35 條對 EM 記錄保存的要求，資料保存期限不少於產品有效期後 1 年。
blocks.en: URS-EM-004 (regulatory requirement): The system shall comply with the EM record retention requirements of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) clause 9.35, with data retained for no less than 1 year after product expiry.

blocks.zh: 注意：每條需求都可以獨立被測試，並追溯到法規要求。
blocks.en: Note: each requirement can be tested independently and traced back to a regulatory requirement.

blocks.zh: 「符合 Part 11」不是需求
blocks.en: "Comply with Part 11" is not a requirement

blocks.zh: 這是 CDMO 最常見的錯誤。「系統應符合 21 CFR Part 11」是一個合規聲明，不是需求。監管機構真正要看的是：你的系統具體實作了哪些功能來達成合規？要把合規要求拆解成可驗證的功能需求，才能在 OQ/PQ 中逐條測試。
blocks.en: This is the most common CDMO mistake. "The system shall comply with 21 CFR Part 11" is a compliance statement, not a requirement. What regulators really want to see is which functions your system specifically implements to achieve compliance. Compliance expectations must be broken down into verifiable functional requirements so that each can be tested in OQ/PQ.

blocks.zh: D1.3.3 Contents of the Requirements Specification D1.3.3 需求規格書內容
blocks.en: D1.3.3 Contents of the Requirements Specification

blocks.zh: 中文解說：RS 內容架構
blocks.en: Commentary: Structure of the RS

blocks.zh: RS 的核心問題：「系統需要做什麼」
blocks.en: The core question of the RS: "What does the system need to do?"

blocks.zh: RS（需求規格書）只回答一個問題：系統需要做什麼？ 不回答「怎麼做」。這個界線至關重要：
blocks.en: The RS (Requirements Specification) answers only one question: What does the system need to do? It does not answer "how." This boundary is critical:

blocks.zh: RS 說：「系統需在批次生產完成後 24 小時內，自動發送 QC 審查通知給指定審查員。」
blocks.en: The RS says: "The system shall automatically send a QC review notification to the designated reviewer within 24 hours of batch production completion."

blocks.zh: CS/DS 說：「使用 SMTP 服務透過 Exchange Server 發送 HTML 格式通知郵件，觸發條件為批次狀態欄位變更為 'Released'。」
blocks.en: The CS/DS says: "Use the SMTP service via Exchange Server to send an HTML-format notification email, triggered when the batch status field changes to 'Released'."

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見陷阱：RS 裡塞入設計細節
blocks.en: Common CDMO pitfall: design details in the RS

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 的 URS 會寫：「系統應使用 Oracle Database 18c 作為後端資料庫。」這是設計細節，不是需求。正確的需求應該是：「系統資料庫應支援多用戶並發存取，回應時間不超過 2 秒，並提供完整的備份還原機制。」
blocks.en: Many CDMO URSs say: "The system shall use Oracle Database 18c as the back-end database." This is a design detail, not a requirement. The correct requirement would be: "The system database shall support concurrent multi-user access with a response time of no more than 2 seconds, and shall provide a complete backup and restore mechanism."

blocks.zh: 指定特定技術的問題：萬一供應商不用 Oracle？你的需求立刻排除了所有其他合格供應商，且這個限制毫無業務理由。
blocks.en: The problem with specifying a particular technology: what if the supplier does not use Oracle? Your requirement immediately excludes every other qualified supplier, and the restriction has no business justification.

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡需求：具體範例
blocks.en: Audit trail requirements: a concrete example

blocks.zh: 「稽核軌跡」通常在 RS 中被空泛地要求。一個合格的數據需求應該這樣寫：
blocks.en: "Audit trail" is often requested only vaguely in an RS. A well-formed data requirement should be written like this:

blocks.zh: 哪些欄位需要稽核軌跡（全部？只有 GMP critical？）
blocks.en: Which fields need an audit trail (all of them? only GMP-critical ones?)

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡記錄應包含：原始值、新值、修改人 ID、時間戳記（UTC+時區）、修改原因（強制輸入）
blocks.en: The audit trail record shall include: original value, new value, ID of the person making the change, timestamp (UTC + time zone), and reason for change (mandatory entry)

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡記錄應不可被任何使用者修改或刪除（包含系統管理員）
blocks.en: The audit trail record shall not be modifiable or deletable by any user (including system administrators)

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡應可被 QA 獨立查閱，不需要技術支援
blocks.en: The audit trail shall be reviewable independently by QA, without technical support

blocks.zh: 這四個子項目都可以在 OQ 測試中逐一驗證。
blocks.en: All four of these sub-items can be verified one by one in OQ testing.

blocks.zh: CDMO LIMS 需求分類練習
blocks.en: CDMO LIMS requirements classification exercise

blocks.zh: 下列項目應歸入哪個需求類別？
blocks.en: Which requirement category should each of the following items fall into?

blocks.zh: D1.3.2 & D1.4 — Ownership and Requirements Capture D1.3.2 & D1.4 — 所有權與需求蒐集
blocks.en: D1.3.2 & D1.4 — Ownership and Requirements Capture

blocks.zh: 中文解說：需求捕捉實務
blocks.en: Commentary: Requirements Capture in Practice

blocks.zh: 業務流程擁有者：最重要的人
blocks.en: The business process owner: the most important person

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 強調：需求的所有權屬於業務流程擁有者（business process owner），不是 IT 部門，也不是供應商。在 CDMO 場景中：
blocks.en: GAMP 5 stresses that ownership of requirements belongs to the business process owner, not to the IT department or the supplier. In a CDMO setting:

blocks.zh: LIMS 需求 → QC 主管或 QA 主管
blocks.en: LIMS requirements → QC manager or QA manager

blocks.zh: EBR/MES 需求 → 生產主管或工藝開發
blocks.en: EBR/MES requirements → production manager or process development

blocks.zh: 環境監控系統 → 設施工程 + QA
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring system → facilities engineering + QA

blocks.zh: IT 部門的角色是技術顧問，確保需求在技術上可行，但不應主導業務需求的內容。
blocks.en: The role of IT is that of technical adviser, ensuring that requirements are technically feasible, but IT should not drive the content of the business requirements.

blocks.zh: 「今天的流程不是最佳解」
blocks.en: "Today's process is not the best solution"

blocks.zh: 這是需求捕捉中最容易被忽視的一點。許多專案在訪談時詢問「現在怎麼做」，然後就把現有的紙本流程直接轉成系統需求。
blocks.en: This is the point most easily overlooked in requirements capture. Many projects ask in interviews "How do you do it now?" and then convert the existing paper-based process directly into system requirements.

blocks.zh: 但現有的流程可能充滿了「因為以前沒有系統才這樣做」的手動步驟。導入 LIMS 的機會，是重新設計流程，而不是把不良習慣數位化。
blocks.en: But the current process may be full of manual steps that exist only because "there was no system before." Implementing a LIMS is an opportunity to redesign the process, not to digitize bad habits.

blocks.zh: 好的問題應該是：「如果你能從零開始設計這個流程，你會怎麼做？」而不是「你現在怎麼做？」
blocks.en: A good question is: "If you could design this process from scratch, how would you do it?" rather than "How do you do it now?"

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見陷阱：範圍蔓延 (Scope Creep)
blocks.en: Common CDMO pitfall: scope creep

blocks.zh: 需求捕捉階段最常見的問題是範圍蔓延。每位利益關係人都想把自己的「nice to have」加入 RS。防止方法：
blocks.en: The most common problem in the requirements capture phase is scope creep. Every stakeholder wants to add their own "nice to have" to the RS. Ways to prevent it:

blocks.zh: 每條需求標記優先級：Mandatory / Beneficial / Nice to have
blocks.en: Mark each requirement with a priority: Mandatory / Beneficial / Nice to have

blocks.zh: 在 RS 批准後，任何新增需求必須走正式的 Change Control
blocks.en: After the RS is approved, any new requirement must go through formal change control

blocks.zh: 記錄哪個利益關係人提出了哪個需求（可追溯性）
blocks.en: Record which stakeholder raised which requirement (traceability)

blocks.zh: 定期做 RS Review，確認沒有悄悄新增未批准的需求
blocks.en: Conduct periodic RS reviews to confirm that no unapproved requirements have been quietly added

blocks.zh: Appendix D2 — Functional Specifications (Retired) Appendix D2 — 功能規格（已廢止）
blocks.en: Appendix D2 — Functional Specifications (Retired)

blocks.zh: 中文解說：D2 退役的意義
blocks.en: Commentary: What the Retirement of D2 Means

blocks.zh: 為什麼廢除 FRS 獨立附錄？
blocks.en: Why was the separate FRS appendix abolished?

blocks.zh: 第一版 GAMP 5 將 URS 和 FRS 分為兩個獨立附錄，實務中造成了一個問題：許多公司搞不清楚一條需求應該放在 URS 還是 FRS，導致文件重複、需求散落兩份文件，維護困難。
blocks.en: The first edition of GAMP 5 treated the URS and FRS as two separate appendices. In practice this caused a problem: many companies could not tell whether a requirement belonged in the URS or the FRS, leading to duplicated documents, requirements scattered across two documents, and difficult maintenance.

blocks.zh: 第二版的做法更實用：需求統一放在 RS，只要結構清晰（業務需求、功能需求、數據需求、技術需求等分節），就能服務所有目的。
blocks.en: The second edition takes a more practical approach: requirements are placed together in the RS, and as long as the structure is clear (separate sections for business requirements, functional requirements, data requirements, technical requirements, and so on), it can serve all purposes.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的實際影響：如果你現有的 SOP 規定要同時產出 URS 和 FRS，可以考慮合併成一份結構完整的 RS。但若已有 validated 系統使用舊格式，不需要強制升級——監管機構更在意的是需求是否完整、可追溯，而不是文件叫什麼名字。
blocks.en: Practical impact for CDMOs: if your current SOP requires producing both a URS and an FRS, consider merging them into a single well-structured RS. However, if validated systems already use the old format, there is no need to force an upgrade - regulators care more about whether the requirements are complete and traceable than about what the document is called.

blocks.zh: Appendix D3 — Configuration and Design: Introduction & Overview Appendix D3 — 組態與設計：簡介與概述
blocks.en: Appendix D3 — Configuration and Design: Introduction & Overview

blocks.zh: 中文解說：CS vs. DS — COTS 與客製軟體
blocks.en: Commentary: CS vs. DS - COTS and Custom Software

blocks.zh: 配置規格 (CS) vs. 設計規格 (DS)
blocks.en: Configuration Specification (CS) vs. Design Specification (DS)

blocks.zh: 這是 Appendix D3 最核心的區分：
blocks.en: This is the core distinction in Appendix D3:

blocks.zh: Configuration Specification (CS)：用於已存在的商業軟體 (COTS) 或可配置產品。你不修改原始碼，只設定參數。CS 記錄「我把這個設定設為什麼值，以及為什麼這樣設。」
blocks.en: Configuration Specification (CS): used for existing commercial off-the-shelf software (COTS) or configurable products. You do not modify the source code; you only set parameters. The CS records "what value I set this setting to, and why."

blocks.zh: Design Specification (DS)：用於客製化軟體開發。你要設計模組、定義數據結構、撰寫邏輯。DS 記錄「軟體怎麼被建構的。」
blocks.en: Design Specification (DS): used for custom software development. You design the modules, define the data structures and write the logic. The DS records "how the software was built."

blocks.zh: 比喻：LIMS 配置 vs. 客製系統設計
blocks.en: Analogy: LIMS configuration vs. custom system design

blocks.zh: COTS LIMS（例如 LabWare）：不需要 DS。你需要的是 CS，記錄：哪個樣品類型啟用了哪些欄位？哪個工作流程啟用了電子簽名？稽核軌跡的保存設定是多少天？
blocks.en: COTS LIMS (for example LabWare): no DS is needed. What you need is a CS recording: which fields are enabled for which sample types? Which workflows have electronic signatures enabled? How many days is the audit trail retention set to?

blocks.zh: 客製開發的 MES 模組：需要 DS。詳述：批次記錄的資料庫 schema、每個功能模組的邏輯流程圖、各模組之間的 API 介面定義。
blocks.en: Custom-developed MES module: a DS is needed, detailing the database schema of the batch record, the logic flow diagram of each functional module, and the API interface definitions between modules.

blocks.zh: 關鍵：如果你無法修改軟體的原始碼（COTS），就不需要 DS——因為軟體的設計由供應商負責，你的責任是配置正確並驗證配置符合你的需求。
blocks.en: Key point: if you cannot modify the software's source code (COTS), you do not need a DS - the design of the software is the supplier's responsibility, and your responsibility is to configure it correctly and verify that the configuration meets your requirements.

blocks.zh: CDMO 陷阱：過度指定 COTS 系統的需求
blocks.en: CDMO pitfall: over-specifying requirements for COTS systems

blocks.zh: 這是 CDMO 採購標準 LIMS 時的常見問題：在 RS 裡寫入非常詳細的配置細節，例如「稽核軌跡畫面需要有特定的欄位排列順序」。
blocks.en: This is a common problem when CDMOs procure a standard LIMS: the RS contains very detailed configuration details, for example "the audit trail screen shall have a specific field order."

blocks.zh: 問題在於：COTS 軟體的 UI 是固定的，你無法改變。如果 RS 要求不可能實現的配置，要麼你的 RS 永遠無法被滿足，要麼你需要不斷地 justify deviation。
blocks.en: The problem is that the UI of COTS software is fixed and you cannot change it. If the RS demands a configuration that is impossible to achieve, either your RS can never be met, or you will have to keep justifying deviations.

blocks.zh: 正確做法：RS 描述業務需求（能查詢稽核軌跡），CS 記錄系統提供的實際配置（稽核軌跡在 Admin > Reports > Audit Trail 模組），並確認它滿足業務需求。
blocks.en: The correct approach: the RS describes the business requirement (the audit trail can be queried), the CS records the actual configuration the system provides (the audit trail is in the Admin > Reports > Audit Trail module), and confirms that it meets the business requirement.

blocks.zh: SaaS / 雲端系統的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special considerations for SaaS / cloud systems

blocks.zh: 當使用雲端 SaaS 系統（例如 Veeva Vault QMS）時：
blocks.en: When using a cloud SaaS system (for example Veeva Vault QMS):

blocks.zh: CS/DS 通常由服務供應商維護
blocks.en: The CS/DS is usually maintained by the service provider

blocks.zh: CDMO 應要求供應商提供系統配置文件，並在質量協議中明確要求
blocks.en: The CDMO should ask the supplier for system configuration documentation and make this an explicit requirement in the quality agreement

blocks.zh: CDMO 需要產出「補充配置規格」，記錄你在 SaaS 系統中做的客戶端配置（如工作流程、角色權限、自定義欄位）
blocks.en: The CDMO needs to produce a "supplementary configuration specification" recording the customer-side configuration you make in the SaaS system (such as workflows, role permissions and custom fields)

blocks.zh: 供應商的基礎設施驗證（IQ）由供應商承擔，但你需要確認他們有適當的 SOC 2 或等效認證
blocks.en: The supplier is responsible for qualification (IQ) of its infrastructure, but you need to confirm that it holds appropriate SOC 2 or equivalent certification

blocks.zh: D3.3.3 Configuration Specification Content D3.3.3 組態規格內容
blocks.en: D3.3.3 Configuration Specification Content

blocks.zh: 中文解說：CS 的關鍵要素
blocks.en: Commentary: Key Elements of the CS

blocks.zh: 配置管理：設定不能隨便改
blocks.en: Configuration management: settings must not be changed casually

blocks.zh: 一旦系統通過驗證（已核准的配置基準 Configuration Baseline），任何配置更改都需要走 Change Control 程序，重新評估影響並進行再驗證。
blocks.en: Once the system has been validated (an approved Configuration Baseline), any configuration change must follow the change control procedure, with the impact reassessed and revalidation performed.

blocks.zh: 常見問題：IT 管理員在維護時「順手」改了某個系統參數（例如把 Session 逾時從 30 分鐘改成 120 分鐘），沒有走 Change Control。這在稽核時是重大缺失，因為已驗證狀態（Validated State）已被破壞。
blocks.en: A common problem: an IT administrator changes a system parameter "while at it" during maintenance (for example changing the session timeout from 30 minutes to 120 minutes) without going through change control. This is a major finding in an audit, because the Validated State has been compromised.

blocks.zh: CS 最重要的欄位：「為什麼這樣設定」
blocks.en: The most important field in a CS: "why it is set this way"

blocks.zh: 一份合格的配置規格不只記錄「設定值是什麼」，更要記錄「為什麼這樣設定」——並連結到 RS 中對應的需求 ID。
blocks.en: A good Configuration Specification records not only "what the setting value is" but also "why it is set this way," linked to the corresponding requirement ID in the RS.

blocks.zh: 例如：
blocks.en: For example:

blocks.zh: 這個追溯結構，讓驗證測試人員在撰寫 OQ/PQ 測試案例時，能直接對應到 CS 中的配置，再對應到 RS 中的需求。
blocks.en: This traceability structure lets validation testers, when writing OQ/PQ test cases, map directly to the configuration in the CS and then to the requirement in the RS.

blocks.zh: D3.3.4 Hardware Design Specification D3.3.4 硬體設計規格
blocks.en: D3.3.4 Hardware Design Specification

blocks.zh: 中文解說：硬體設計規格
blocks.en: Commentary: Hardware Design Specification

blocks.zh: 哪種系統需要硬體 DS？
blocks.en: Which systems need a hardware DS?

blocks.zh: 並非所有電腦化系統都需要硬體 DS。以下是判斷指南：
blocks.en: Not every computerized system needs a hardware DS. The following is a guide for deciding:

blocks.zh: 需要 HDS：客製化嵌入式控制系統（如灌裝機 PLC 控制盤）、客製化硬體整合（如特殊感測器介面）、複雜的網路架構設計
blocks.en: HDS needed: custom embedded control systems (such as a filling machine PLC control panel), custom hardware integration (such as a special sensor interface), complex network architecture design

blocks.zh: 通常不需要 HDS：標準 COTS 軟體執行在供應商提供的伺服器上、SaaS 系統（硬體由雲端供應商管理）、標準 PC 工作站執行 LIMS 用戶端
blocks.en: HDS usually not needed: standard COTS software running on supplier-provided servers, SaaS systems (hardware managed by the cloud provider), standard PC workstations running a LIMS client

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：環境條件需求
blocks.en: CDMO practice: environmental condition requirements

blocks.zh: 在無菌製藥 CDMO 環境中，硬體設計需特別注意：
blocks.en: In a sterile pharmaceutical CDMO environment, hardware design needs particular attention to:

blocks.zh: 潔淨室內的觸控螢幕：IP 防護等級（通常需要 IP65+）、易清潔表面設計
blocks.en: Touchscreens in cleanrooms: IP protection rating (usually IP65+ is required) and easy-to-clean surface design

blocks.zh: 電磁干擾 (EMI)：灌裝設備的電機可能影響附近的 PLC 訊號，需要適當屏蔽
blocks.en: Electromagnetic interference (EMI): the motors of filling equipment may affect nearby PLC signals, so appropriate shielding is required

blocks.zh: UPS 需求：批次記錄系統在停電時必須有足夠時間完成資料儲存
blocks.en: UPS requirements: a batch record system must have enough time to finish saving data during a power outage

blocks.zh: 嵌入式系統（灌裝機）：必須有硬體設計文件（P&ID、電氣圖）才能進行 IQ
blocks.en: Embedded systems (filling machines): hardware design documents (P&ID, electrical drawings) must exist before IQ can be performed

blocks.zh: D3.3.5 Software Design Specification D3.3.5 軟體設計規格
blocks.en: D3.3.5 Software Design Specification

blocks.zh: 中文解說：軟體設計規格與可追溯性
blocks.en: Commentary: Software Design Specification and Traceability

blocks.zh: 追溯性：從需求到設計，再到測試
blocks.en: Traceability: from requirements to design to testing

blocks.zh: DS 不只是技術文件，它是驗證計畫的骨架。完整的追溯矩陣結構：
blocks.en: The DS is not just a technical document; it is the skeleton of the validation plan. The structure of a complete traceability matrix:

blocks.zh: RS 需求 ID → CS/DS 設計章節 → 驗證測試案例 ID → 測試結果
blocks.en: RS requirement ID → CS/DS design section → validation test case ID → test result

blocks.zh: RS-SEC-003（密碼最短 8 字元）→ CS 第 4.2 節（密碼策略配置）→ OQ-TC-015（密碼長度驗證測試）→ PASS
blocks.en: RS-SEC-003 (minimum password length of 8 characters) → CS section 4.2 (password policy configuration) → OQ-TC-015 (password length verification test) → PASS

blocks.zh: RS-AUDIT-007（批次數據修改記錄稽核軌跡）→ DS 模組 3.4（稽核軌跡引擎設計）→ OQ-TC-042（稽核軌跡完整性測試）→ PASS
blocks.en: RS-AUDIT-007 (audit trail for batch data modification records) → DS module 3.4 (audit trail engine design) → OQ-TC-042 (audit trail integrity test) → PASS

blocks.zh: 沒有追溯矩陣，驗證測試就是「測了什麼東西」，而不是「證明了系統滿足了哪些需求」。
blocks.en: Without a traceability matrix, validation testing is just "what was tested," rather than "proof of which requirements the system meets."

blocks.zh: 設計審查 (Design Review)：不只是文件審查
blocks.en: Design review: more than a document review

blocks.zh: Appendix M5 更詳細地涵蓋設計審查。但 D3 中的核心訊息是：設計審查是確保 CS/DS 正確的關鍵步驟。
blocks.en: Appendix M5 covers design review in more detail. But the core message in D3 is that design review is the key step for ensuring the CS/DS is correct.

blocks.zh: 誰需要參加設計審查？
blocks.en: Who needs to take part in the design review?

blocks.zh: 系統擁有者（System Owner）
blocks.en: System Owner

blocks.zh: 業務流程擁有者（Business Process Owner）
blocks.en: Business Process Owner

blocks.zh: IT 代表（確認技術可行性）
blocks.en: IT representative (confirms technical feasibility)

blocks.zh: QA 代表（確認 GxP 合規性）
blocks.en: QA representative (confirms GxP compliance)

blocks.zh: 驗證工程師（確認可驗證性）
blocks.en: Validation engineer (confirms verifiability)

blocks.zh: 設計審查要檢查什麼？
blocks.en: What should the design review check?

blocks.zh: 每個 RS 需求都有對應的 CS/DS 章節嗎？（完整性）
blocks.en: Does every RS requirement have a corresponding CS/DS section? (completeness)

blocks.zh: 配置/設計是否確實滿足了需求？（充分性）
blocks.en: Does the configuration/design actually meet the requirement? (adequacy)

blocks.zh: 配置/設計是否引入了 RS 中未提及的功能？（範圍控制）
blocks.en: Does the configuration/design introduce functions not mentioned in the RS? (scope control)

blocks.zh: 所有 GxP critical 需求都有對應的驗證測試案例嗎？
blocks.en: Does every GxP-critical requirement have a corresponding validation test case?

blocks.zh: CDMO 陷阱：不做設計審查
blocks.en: CDMO pitfall: skipping the design review

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 跳過設計審查，直接進入 OQ 測試。結果是在 OQ 時才發現設計（或配置）與需求不符，需要重做配置並重新測試，浪費大量時間。
blocks.en: Many CDMOs skip the design review and go straight to OQ testing. The result is that a mismatch between the design (or configuration) and the requirements is discovered only during OQ, requiring the configuration to be redone and retested, wasting a great deal of time.

blocks.zh: 設計審查的成本永遠低於驗證後的返工。一般規則：在開始 IQ/OQ 之前，CS/DS 必須已完成設計審查並核准。
blocks.en: The cost of a design review is always lower than rework after validation. As a general rule: before IQ/OQ starts, the CS/DS must have completed design review and been approved.

blocks.zh: 多租戶 SaaS：數據隔離的重要性
blocks.en: Multi-tenant SaaS: the importance of data segregation

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 使用多租戶 SaaS 系統（例如 Veeva Vault）時，DS 必須清楚說明各租戶的數據如何隔離。這對 CDMO 尤其重要，因為你可能同時為多個客戶（Sponsor）管理數據，必須確保客戶 A 的數據不可被客戶 B 存取。這項需求通常需要在供應商的安全架構審查中確認，並記錄在質量協議中。
blocks.en: When a CDMO uses a multi-tenant SaaS system (for example Veeva Vault), the DS must clearly explain how each tenant's data is segregated. This is especially important for a CDMO, because you may manage data for several clients (sponsors) at the same time and must ensure that Client A's data cannot be accessed by Client B. This requirement usually needs to be confirmed in the supplier's security architecture review and documented in the quality agreement.

blocks.zh: The Traceability Chain: Requirements → Design → Testing 追溯鏈：需求 → 設計 → 測試
blocks.en: The Traceability Chain: Requirements → Design → Testing

blocks.zh: 中文解說：可追溯性是驗證計畫的骨幹
blocks.en: Commentary: Traceability Is the Backbone of the Validation Plan

blocks.zh: 完整追溯鏈結構
blocks.en: Structure of the complete traceability chain

blocks.zh:
業務流程需求
    ↓
RS 需求 ID（例：RS-GMP-007）
    ↓
法規依據（例：EU GMP Annex 11 §9）
    ↓
CS/DS 章節（例：CS 第 5.3 節：電子簽名配置）
    ↓
驗證測試案例 ID（例：OQ-TC-023）
    ↓
測試結果 + 通過/失敗 + 測試人員簽名

全部整合於「追溯矩陣（Traceability Matrix）」
blocks.en:
Business process requirement
    ↓
RS requirement ID (e.g. RS-GMP-007)
    ↓
Regulatory basis (e.g. EU GMP Annex 11 §9)
    ↓
CS/DS section (e.g. CS section 5.3: electronic signature configuration)
    ↓
Validation test case ID (e.g. OQ-TC-023)
    ↓
Test result + pass/fail + tester signature

All consolidated in the "Traceability Matrix"

blocks.zh: 追溯矩陣的實際用途
blocks.en: Practical uses of the traceability matrix

blocks.zh: 追溯矩陣不是一份「做給查核員看的」文件，它在專案中有實際的工程用途：
blocks.en: The traceability matrix is not a document "made for the inspector"; it has real engineering uses in the project:

blocks.zh: 計畫驗證範疇：所有 GMP critical 需求都需要測試——追溯矩陣讓你確保沒有遺漏
blocks.en: Planning the validation scope: all GMP-critical requirements need to be tested - the traceability matrix lets you ensure none are missed

blocks.zh: 評估變更影響：系統變更時，快速識別哪些需求、哪些測試案例需要重新評估
blocks.en: Assessing change impact: when the system changes, quickly identify which requirements and which test cases need to be reassessed

blocks.zh: 稽核準備：查核員要求「請給我看稽核軌跡需求如何被驗證」——追溯矩陣一秒找到答案
blocks.en: Audit preparation: when an auditor asks, "Show me how the audit trail requirement was verified" - the traceability matrix finds the answer in a second

blocks.zh: 偏差調查：系統出現異常時，快速追溯到相關的設計決策和驗證依據
blocks.en: Deviation investigation: when the system behaves abnormally, quickly trace back to the relevant design decisions and validation evidence

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 章節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: RS is the "what," CS/DS is the "how." A Requirements Specification defines business needs independent of technical solutions. Configuration and Design Specifications explain how those needs will be implemented. Never mix the two. — RS 是「要做什麼」，CS/DS 是「怎麼做」。兩者的界線是驗證邏輯的基礎。
blocks.en: RS is the "what," CS/DS is the "how." A Requirements Specification defines business needs independent of technical solutions. Configuration and Design Specifications explain how those needs will be implemented. Never mix the two.

blocks.zh: SMART requirements enable validation. A requirement that cannot be tested cannot be validated. The most common failure is writing compliance statements instead of testable functional requirements. — 可測試性是 SMART 的核心。「符合 Part 11」不是需求——具體的密碼策略、稽核軌跡欄位才是。
blocks.en: SMART requirements enable validation. A requirement that cannot be tested cannot be validated. The most common failure is writing compliance statements instead of testable functional requirements.

blocks.zh: The requirements hierarchy flows top-down. URS (business) → FRS (functional) → CS/DS (implementation). Each level derives from the one above and must remain traceable to it. — 需求從業務到技術層層細化，每層都可追溯到上一層。
blocks.en: The requirements hierarchy flows top-down. URS (business) → FRS (functional) → CS/DS (implementation). Each level derives from the one above and must remain traceable to it.

blocks.zh: CS for COTS, DS for custom. Configured commercial software needs a Configuration Specification recording parameters and their business justification. Custom-developed software needs a full Design Specification including module architecture, data structures, and algorithms. — COTS 軟體用 CS（記錄配置參數與理由），客製軟體用 DS（設計模組與邏輯）。
blocks.en: CS for COTS, DS for custom. Configured commercial software needs a Configuration Specification recording parameters and their business justification. Custom-developed software needs a full Design Specification including module architecture, data structures, and algorithms.

blocks.zh: Traceability is the backbone of validation. Every requirement should trace forward to a design decision and a test case. The Traceability Matrix is the instrument that makes this explicit, supports impact assessment, and provides evidence for regulatory review. — 追溯矩陣不是裝飾品，是變更控制和稽核防禦的核心工具。
blocks.en: Traceability is the backbone of validation. Every requirement should trace forward to a design decision and a test case. The Traceability Matrix is the instrument that makes this explicit, supports impact assessment, and provides evidence for regulatory review.

blocks.zh: Two critical CDMO pitfalls: over-specifying COTS and under-specifying URS. Over-specifying COTS creates requirements that cannot be met (you can't configure what the software doesn't allow). Under-specifying URS leads to scope creep and a system that doesn't meet business needs. — 對 COTS 過度規格化 → 無法實現的需求；對 URS 規格不足 → 範圍蔓延。兩者都是系統驗證專案失敗的常見原因。
blocks.en: Two critical CDMO pitfalls: over-specifying COTS and under-specifying URS. Over-specifying COTS creates requirements that cannot be met (you can't configure what the software doesn't allow). Under-specifying URS leads to scope creep and a system that doesn't meet business needs.
